docs.question: What is our data retention policy for enterprise customers?
docs.answer: Per current policy, Enterprise customers have **7-year retention** for transactional data [1] and **3 years** for application logs [2]. Purging runs nightly and is logged in the audit trail [1]. Sensitive data (PII) is anonymized at 90 days upon deletion request [2].

multiHop.question: Which support tickets from last week relate to Monday's payments-svc incident?
multiHop.answer: I found **4 correlated tickets** with incident #INC-2049 on payments-svc [1]: two report `/charge` timeouts [2], one reports duplicated refunds [3] and a fourth reports finance dashboard latency [1]. The common root cause is the retry loop without idempotency-key described in the RCA [3].

code.question: Show me how we implemented refresh token rotation.
code.answer: Rotation lives in `RefreshService.rotate()` [1]. It verifies the JWT signature, checks a Redis denylist, appends the consumed `jti`, and issues a new access/refresh pair [2]. The controller uses `validate(RefreshDto)` and maps `RevokedTokenError` to a 401 [1].

sql.question: How much did we bill in LATAM last quarter?
sql.answer: I ran the query against the Snowflake warehouse [1]: **USD 4.82M** in Q4 LATAM, +18% YoY. Per-country breakdown attached [2]. Source: `analytics.fct_revenue_country` materialized hourly [1].

graph.question: Which teams depend on the auth-core service?
graph.answer: The knowledge graph shows **6 teams** consuming `auth-core` [1]: web-platform, mobile, payments-svc, billing, helpdesk and partners-api [2]. payments-svc has the highest traffic (p95 12k req/min) [1]. There are 2 pending mobile deprecations in Q1 [2].

stats.tokens: Total tokens consumed in this session (input + output).
stats.latency: Latency of the last end-to-end run (rewrite → respond).
stats.cost: Aggregated estimated cost in USD for the current session.
stats.cacheHit: Percentage of queries served by the semantic cache (no LLM call).
stats.drift: Drift of embedding distribution vs baseline. >2% needs attention.
stats.faithfulness: How faithfully the answer reflects retrieved chunks. Target ≥90%.
stats.hallucination: Automatic detection of unsupported claims. Target <1%.
